Indian stock markets see mixed performance, small caps decline

Indian stock markets experienced a mixed trading session, with the benchmark Sensex gaining approximately 350 points and the Nifty approaching 22,750. However, the broader market saw a decline, as small and midcap stocks fell by nearly 1%. The Nifty recovered from early losses to close up 91 points, but a significant number of stocks, 432, hit their 52-week lows.
